name: residential_pollution_byte
description: Test 14 (REH test 15, RS3). hqLoss sums GetPollutionValue over the S x S = 16 cells of a tract as a wrapping u32, divides by S x S unsigned, and keeps the low byte. Air source 300 in every cell -> 4800 / 16 = 300 -> 300 mod 256 = 44; the shipped air curve (0, 0)(512, 0.1)(1024, 50) gives 44 / 512 x 0.1 = 0.0085938, so hqLoss = ((0.2 + 0.0085938) + water(0)) + garbage(0) = 0.2085938. Air 600 -> 88 -> 0.2 + 0.0171875 = 0.2171875; air 256 -> 0 -> exactly 0.2f (0x3E4CCCCD). Through DoPopulationChange a steady tract at HQ 10 loses 0.2085938 -> 9.7914062.
